chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Al-Ḥārith ibn Muḥammad, from Zayd, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who had intercourse with his wife in her rear and persisted against her until she died from that, he عليه السلام said: “He is liable for the blood money (diyyah).”

key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: blood money; the legally mandated financial compensation for wrongful killing
key_terms.فِي دُبُرِهَا: in her rear; the specific sexual act described in the case
key_terms.مَاتَتْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ: she died from that; indicating the act directly caused her death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a husband’s sexual act causes his wife’s death?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a husband whose conduct caused his wife's death. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام rules that he is liable for the diyyah, establishing financial liability for fatal harm within marriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5327 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Harith ibn Muhammad from Zayd from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) regarding a man who had intercourse with his wife in her rear and persisted until she died from it.
Imam (as) said: "He must pay the full blood money (diyyah)."
